title: Don't Buy AI, Buy the Outcome
summary: Event tech’s real differentiator isn't AI, it's whether the technology saves time, improves attendee experiences, or drives measurable business results.

summary: This week’s cancellation of a prominent African financial conference comes as confirmed Ebola cases surge, raising questions about whether more meetings will follow.

title: Gendered Ageism: The Events Industry’s Chronic Issue
